test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Irrational
solution:
The correct answer is **"Reasonable".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Reasonable"** is the most appropriate antonym.
 
• The word **"Reasonable"** means- sensible or practical.
 
 
• **Example: **Her most of the arguments were reasonable that she rose in the Parliament.
 
 
 
• While the word** "irrational"** means - not based on reason or clear thought/ impractical.
 
 
• **Example: **Her sister has an irrational fear of cats.
 
 
 
• Thus,*** option 3)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Gloomy: **sad/ full of sorrow without hopes.

 
 
• **Example: **Riya seems to be gloomy after she lost her husband.
 
 
 
• **Illogical: **Not sensible
 
 
• **Example: **The student asked the teacher such an illogical question that the whole class was laughing.
 
 
 
• **Peaceful: **Calm, full of peace
 
 
• **Example: **Sitting in the lap of nature is so peaceful and soothing.
